subject: literacy
concept: Writing a concluding sentence that restates the claim in a fresh way
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares an exact repeat of the opening claim to a freshly worded conclusion
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a claim to its best (non-repetitive) concluding restatement
exercise.abstract: Student writes a concluding sentence for their own short argument that isn't a word-for-word repeat

misconception_flags: repeats the opening sentence word-for-word instead of restating it freshly

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
